topPRs.title: Update release docs: op-proposer v1.16.6, op-challenger v1.10.0
topPRs.author: mintlify
topPRs.body:
## Summary
Adds the September 25, 2026 op-proposer and op-challenger releases.

## Changes
- Prepended op-proposer v1.16.6 (Latest, Stable) and demoted v1.16.5 to Stable
- Prepended op-challenger v1.10.0 (Latest, Stable) and demoted v1.9.6 to Stable
- Updated both cards in `releases/index.mdx`

## Context
No other tracked components published releases in the review window. proxyd v4.32.3 and op-deployer v0.8.0-pr.22965.1 are already covered by open PRs #23036 and #22992.
